title: routers/auth.py — POST /auth/login (open) + GET /auth/me (auth required)
scope: FastAPI router with prefix='/auth', tags=['auth']. Two endpoints: (1) POST /login — open (NO get_current_user dep), accepts OAuth2PasswordRequestForm (form body), delegates to AuthService.authenticate, returns TokenResponse; (2) GET /me — route-level Depends(get_current_user), returns UserRead of the authenticated user.

success_criteria.manual: python -c "from src.presentation.api.routers.auth import router; print([r.path for r in router.routes])"
success_criteria.automated: TC-208 (valid login -> 200 TokenResponse with bearer token), TC-209 (wrong password -> 401), TC-210 (GET /auth/me with valid token -> 200 UserRead).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: auth.py with 2 routes. POST /login open (no auth dep on router). GET /me uses get_current_user at route level. AuthService.authenticate called on login.

checkout_prompt: routers/auth.py created. POST /auth/login (open, OAuth2PasswordRequestForm) + GET /auth/me (get_current_user dep). TC-208/209/210 covered.
